adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` object does not include any `team` field (it only sets `organizer`, `attendees`, `destinationCalendar`, etc.). Yet `sendAddGuestsEmails` in `email-manager.ts` formats the event and conditionally notifies team members only under `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`. From the diff alone, there is no path that populates `calEvent.team.members`, so this notification loop will never execute, meaning team members (beyond the main organizer email) will not be notified when guests are added despite the presence of code intended to do so.
